name: Box Object Extraction & Return Procedure
description: Astronaut opens the containment box, extracts one object, returns the object into the box, and closes the box.

0.name: IDLE
0.instruction: System initialized. Please open the box.

1.name: BOX_OPENED
1.instruction: Box opened. Next step: Please take out the object.

2.name: OBJECT_EXTRACTED
2.instruction: Object extracted. Next step: Please return the object into the box.

3.name: OBJECT_RETURNED
3.instruction: Object returned. Next step: Please close the box.

ERROR_SKIP.alert_tts: Warning: Step skipped. Please extract and return the object before closing the box.
ERROR_SKIP.recovery_prompt: Reopen the box and complete the object extraction and return sequence.

ERROR_SEQ.alert_tts: Warning: Procedural error. The object has not been returned to the box.
ERROR_SEQ.recovery_prompt: Reopen the box and return the object inside before closing.

ERROR_PREMATURE_CLOSE.alert_tts: Warning: Step skipped. Please extract and return the object before closing the box.
ERROR_PREMATURE_CLOSE.recovery_prompt: Reopen the box and complete the object extraction and return sequence.

ERROR_UNRETURNED_CLOSE.alert_tts: Warning: Procedural error. The object has not been returned to the box.
ERROR_UNRETURNED_CLOSE.recovery_prompt: Reopen the box and return the object inside before closing.

STALL_TIMEOUT.alert_tts: Notice: Inactivity detected. Please proceed with the current step.
STALL_TIMEOUT.recovery_prompt: Continue with the active procedure step.
